unresolved.notes:
Not a breakage: the venue's page still carries its September programme, whose only music night (jam session, Sunday 20 September) is now past, so there is nothing to repair.

- Cause: https://dernierbar.com/pages/paris still shows the monthly post "LA RENTRÉE DES CLASSES… (mise à jour du 02/09)" with 11 dated September events. The `dernierbar` parser reads them all correctly (same markup as before: "🎸 DIMANCHE 20 SEPTEMBRE — 17H00" / "LA JAM SESSION"), but all 11 are before today (2026-09-29), hence "0 events parsed (11 outside the window or invalid)". The 1 event at the last success was that 20 September jam.
- No October programme is online yet. The blog (/pages/news) and the embedded Instagram feed announce a few October nights (Loup-Garou party 6 Oct, Stargate party 2 Oct, role-playing game (JDR) nights 10/14/17 Oct), but none of them is a concert or a jam, and they exist only as blog/social posts, not in the programme post the parser reads.
- Changed: nothing (venues.json and venues_html.py untouched). Check result: ok=false, count=0, "0 events parsed (11 outside the window or invalid)", which is the correct outcome for a stale programme.
- For a human: nothing to fix in code. The source should come back by itself once the bar posts its October programme on /pages/paris. If that post never appears, look at the page again: the parser may need a new layout.
- No instructions aimed at the scraper were found in the pages.
